section_summary.extract_value: This section (titled Study 3) reports that Item 8 of the BAS-2 was revised for inclusivity and that the authors re-examined the BAS-2's factor structure and internal consistency with the revised item. They also examined the correlations between BAS-2 scores and BMI and compared those correlations (and mean BAS-2 differences) between the community samples in Study 2 and Study 3 to assess whether the item change affected validity.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Thus, we modified this example to \"I hold my head high and smile.\" Acknowledging that changing an item may alter the BAS-2's structural and psychometric properties, we re-explored the factor structure and internal consistency reliability of the BAS-2 with this revised item to determine whether any substantial alterations were observed. We further examined the strength of the correlations between the BAS-2 and BMI, and compared these correlations to the community participant sample in our Study 2 data, to determine whether the BAS-2's validity evidence may be compromised with this alteration. Last, we examined whether any mean differences in BAS-2 scores were evidenced between the community participant samples in Studies 2 and 3."
